scope: Descriptive audit of all18 completed registered drone development planning runs; no controller/scoring changes or additional simulations.

methodology.comparators: All3 thresholds use strict less-than; success also requires no crash and no workspace escape.
methodology.speed_only_blocker: XY passes, speed fails, all altitude/safety criteria pass at the same native sample.
methodology.counts: Task-instances across models/training seeds, not independent goals. Samples at10Hz; no claims about inter-sample crossings.
methodology.causality_limit: A speed-only blocked sample does not prove a settling command recovers the task. No relaxed-criterion benchmark results are claimed.
methodology.trace_npz: Hashes retained as references; measurements come from consolidated JSON, so NPZ payloads are not revalidated here.

interpretation.main_observation: 111/114 failures never enter XY<4cm. Only3/114 enter but fail solely speed:4 planned native samples, no support samples.
interpretation.priority: Investigate visual goal geometry and action ranking first. Settling-aware costs are a secondary hypothesis needing fresh matched evaluation.
interpretation.objective: LatentGoalCost.get_cost uses final predicted latent goal MSE without an explicit speed/altitude/safety term. This mismatch exists but is not the dominant observed failure mode.
